body:
OBSERVED 2026-08-09. Surfaced by the CWNG KOBO research session; every claim below
re-verified independently here before filing.

THE CAPABILITY EXISTS AND WORKS. The cwasync KOReader plugin has its own in-plugin
UI - a "Sync KOReader highlights" toggle and a "Sync highlights now" action
(koreader/plugins/cwasync.koplugin/main.lua:405-422). Server-to-Nickel write-back is
hardware-proven: notes/feat-annotation-phase2-realdb-verification.md:35-48 records the
provider's exact 17-column row inserted into the operator's real KoboReader.sqlite and
rendered by stock Nickel - correct passage, green, note visible, operator-confirmed by
device photo on 2026-05-26.

NEITHER UI SAYS SO. Grepping cps/templates/ and frontend/src/ for KOReader highlight
or annotation surfaces returns nothing but whatsNew.ts entries - release-note history,
not a control or an explanation.

AND THE DEDICATED PAGE DOESN'T EITHER. cps/templates/kosync_plugin.html is the
plugin's own page. Its sections are: Get the Plugin / Installation / Keeping It Up To
Date / Accessing the Plugin / Plugin Configuration / "Using the Sync Feature" /
Troubleshooting. It contains ZERO occurrences of "highlight" or "annotation". So a
user who finds the right page and reads the section literally named "Using the Sync
Feature" still does not learn that highlights sync at all.

COMPOUNDING: that page is CLASSIC-ONLY. Nothing in Account.tsx or Sidebar.tsx links
it, so after a root flip an SPA user cannot reach even the incomplete documentation.

WHY THIS IS ITS OWN CATEGORY - AND A LIMIT ON F-f1159f'S METHOD. The parity audit is a
DIFFERENTIAL: it finds controls present in classic and absent from the SPA. A
capability exposed in NEITHER UI is invisible to it by construction. This is the first
confirmed instance of that third category, and it means the ~30-item count in F-f1159f
is a floor for "SPA is missing this", not a ceiling on "users cannot reach this".
Anything shipped but never surfaced will not appear in that audit no matter how
carefully it is run.

NOT IN SCOPE HERE: whether the plugin-driven end-to-end should ship default-on. CWNG
KOBO reports Tests 1-2 of feat-annotation-koreader-bridge-device-verification.md were
never run on hardware, which is why the toggle is default-off. That gate is remaining
work on a proven mechanism, and it is their call, not this finding's.

REMEDY: (1) say on kosync_plugin.html that highlights and notes sync, in the section
that already claims to describe the sync feature; (2) give the page an SPA route, or
add it to the root-flip legacy-link list; (3) surface the capability where a user
looking for it would look - the book page or Account, not only inside the device.

RELATED: F-f1159f (parity audit), M1 and M25 on notes/SPA-ROOT-FLIP-WORKLIST.md.
Credit: CWNG KOBO.
title: KOReader highlight sync is hardware-proven, shipped, and advertised in neither UI
